verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hosted software that can be deployed on any server, OS, or architecture the operator chooses (Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Kubernetes; single-server or replicated setups), which inherently gives full control over where data physically resides. However, there is no explicit documentation framing this as a 'data residency/region' feature or guidance for compliance-driven region selection. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/compliance documentation, region-specific deployment guidance, no independent corroboration of residency control beyond general self-hosting flexibility.
